svg.text: Native HA — Preserve Battery During Grid Outages
Actual confirmed grid + fresh SOC, not the historical Grid Confidence label
1 · CONFIRM THE CONDITIONS
Use fresh, settled confirmed grid evidence
Grid state must agree with measured voltage
Existing grid confirmation: 180 seconds
Stale, pending or contradictory data blocks action
2 · FOUR FLEXIBLE PLUGS
Without confirmed grid, SOC <40% requests OFF
Water pump, boiler, HP2 and HP3
Save original states before the protection action
HP1 relay and microwave are excluded
3 · FOUR-PLUG RESTORATION
SOC >50% off-grid or confirmed grid return
Only saved eligible ON states are restored
Require overload idle and inverter load <50%
Deferred recovery checks retained pending states
4 · FRIDGE · SEPARATE LAST RESORT
Without confirmed grid, SOC <20% requests OFF
SOC >30% or confirmed grid return permits ON
Restore only the fridge OFF owned by this rule
No compressor minimum-OFF timer is promised
5 · PROTECTIONS COOPERATE
Preserve original intent across overlapping cycles
Battery recovery cannot undo active overload OFF
Native state/helpers survive normal restart paths
Disabling protection is not an immediate ON action
6 · FIRST-FLOOR HP IS DIFFERENT
HP1 climate battery policy remains in EH code
Configured stop/recovery defaults: 40% / 50%
Guarded HA climate execution and manual ownership
Do not cut the HP1 monitoring relay for this rule
Native saved ON intention can override a newer external OFF. Fridge commissioning and food/compressor safety need owner
review.
